canrpgcat.Name: Cat Form (hyena placeholder)
canrpgcat._comment_AnimationsMetaData: Cat Form is backed by the vanilla HYENA mesh for now (no feline exists in vanilla) - swap the shape/texture for a real cat later without touching code (model code stays 'canrpgcat'). Remaps the player's seraph locomotion codes onto the hyena shape's OWN animations. The shape carries two roots - invisible seraph pivots (required or the player renderer crashes) and 'Body' (the hyena mesh, with its own neck/head the head-controller tracks). CRITICAL: the target 'animation' MUST equal the seraph code, so the hyena 'Run' clip was renamed to 'sprint' in the shape.
